name: Meclonazepam
summary: A benzodiazepine related to clonazepam discovered by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1960s. The drug is suspected to be useful in treating schistosomiasis. The drug has been sold on the grey market as a recreational drug but has not seen widespread popularity.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet

pharmacology.text: Its sedative and anxiolytic abilities are attributed to the same mechanism used by other benzodiazepine drugs: modulation of the GABAA receptor in the brain. This psychoactive activity makes it useful for recreational use. The sedating side effect would also make it unsuitable for routine use as an antiparasitical.

uses.text: Meclonazepam was never used as a medicine and has instead appeared online as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 甲氯西泮（英語：Meclonazepam，也稱為-3-甲基氯硝西泮，-3-methylclonazepam）是一種含氮有機氯化合物，分子式C16H12ClN3O3，為苯二氮䓬類化合物，1970年代由羅氏製藥的科研團隊開發，能作為鎮靜劑和抗焦慮藥。
summaryZhHans: 甲氯西泮（英语：Meclonazepam，也称为-3-甲基氯硝西泮，-3-methylclonazepam）是一种含氮有机氯化合物，分子式C16H12ClN3O3，为苯二氮䓬类化合物，1970年代由罗氏制药的科研团队开发，能作为镇静剂和抗焦虑药。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. As a benzodiazepine, it can be expected to cause drowsiness, muscle relaxation, poor coordination, memory loss and confusion. Like other benzodiazepines, regular use can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures. Too much can dangerously slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。作為苯二氮平類，可預期它會引起嗜睡、肌肉放鬆、協調變差、失憶與混亂。和其他苯二氮平類一樣，經常使用可能導致依賴，長期使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷，包括癲癇發作。過量可能使呼吸危險地減慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。作为苯二氮平类，可预期它会引起嗜睡、肌肉放松、协调制差、失忆与混乱。和其他苯二氮平类一样，经常使用可能导致依赖，长期使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断，包括癫痫发作。过量可能使呼吸危险地减慢。

fact.en: Roche chemists found that meclonazepam, a close relative of clonazepam, can kill the parasitic worms that cause schistosomiasis, a very unusual property for a benzodiazepine.
fact.zh: 羅氏藥廠的化學家發現，氯硝西泮的近親甲氯西泮能殺死引起血吸蟲病的寄生蟲，這對苯二氮平類來說是非常罕見的特性。
fact.zhHans: 罗氏药厂的化学家发现，氯硝西泮的近亲甲氯西泮能杀死引起血吸虫病的寄生虫，这对苯二氮平类来说是非常罕见的特性。
